description: Defines data structures, function prototypes, and macros for managing fast, simple buffers in C, including buffer initialization, manipulation, and memory management functions.

methods.name: hoedown_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size.

methods.name: hoedown_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array.

methods.name: hoedown_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory to a new size.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_init
methods.description: Initializes a buffer with custom memory allocators.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes a buffer, freeing internal data.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_new
methods.description: Creates a new buffer with specified reallocation unit.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_reset
methods.description: Frees internal data of the buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_grow
methods.description: Increases buffer size to specified value.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_put
methods.description: Appends raw data to buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_puts
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_putc
methods.description: Appends a single character to buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_putf
methods.description: Reads from file and appends to buffer until EOF or error.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_set
methods.description: Replaces buffer contents with raw data.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_sets
methods.description: Replaces buffer contents with a null-terminated string.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_eq
methods.description: Compares buffer data with other data for equality.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_eqs
methods.description: Compares buffer data with a null-terminated string for equality.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_prefix
methods.description: Checks if buffer starts with a given prefix string.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_slurp
methods.description: Removes bytes from the start of the buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_cstr
methods.description: Returns a null-terminated string from buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_printf
methods.description: Formatted print to buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_put_utf8
methods.description: Appends a Unicode codepoint as UTF-8 to buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_buffer_free
methods.description: Frees the buffer.
